segments.oily: Reviewers with oily and acne-prone skin report the powder controls shine through the day and, applied over blemishes, reduces breakouts and redness by the next day.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports itching and burning after use, though she notes it could be an individual reaction.
segments.mature: One reviewer suggests the powder can work on mature skin if applied lightly with the right prep, and another using it past 40 finds it a staple for concealing breakouts.

concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers use it to dab directly onto active blemishes or post-extraction spots, reporting the area dries, shrinks, and is less noticeable by the next day or morning; one found it did not blend or cover red well and does not recommend it.
concerns.blemishes: Several with breakout-prone or acne skin report fewer flare-ups and easier concealment of picked or popped blemishes over weeks of use; no dissent on this point.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report visible redness reduction when used to set makeup or spot-treat breakouts, though one very pale reviewer says the powder itself can look ghostly white unless mixed with a tinted powder.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the powder keeps skin matte throughout the day; one notes it can get slightly patchy by evening and needs a quick blot.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports itching and burning, suggesting a barrier reaction, while others report no irritation.
concerns.aging: One reviewer over 40 with breakout-prone skin finds it a game changer for covering picked or open blemishes; another suggests light application suits mature skin.

aspects.libelle: Powder color too light or yellow

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin and this made my skin itch and burn. Could just be me tho…

I am ao suprised!! This powder got rid of my fungal acne in 2 days. i have SUPER oily skin and acne, but yhis powder has helped keep me more matte all day, and has significantly changed my skin. I used to have fungal acne all over my forehead but now its almost entirely gone ans ive inly used this powder twice. This is a must have for oily acne skin. The only thing is it can ebcome solitchy by the end of the day and collect in certsin areas. But if you notice it a quick blott with a paper towel completly fixes it.

I use this daily to cover redness. I use a primer, a green cream, then I mix this and a tinted powder to "set" the green cream. It works amazing and my redness gets covered good while still looking very natural. However, I am extremely pale and I almost look ghostly white after using too much of this powder. I recommend getting a tinted powder close to skintone if youre using this to cover redness.

This product is a gamechanger for me! I have oily skin that is prone to breakouts. I've been using this product for a month now and my frequency of acne flare-ups have significantly decreased! I did not care for the pad it came with and instead use my own brushes. Post-blemish I use a small brush to target the spot. All other days, I use a foundation brush and put a light layer all over after my setting spray. Keeps me matte and there is no discoloration. 10/10 recommend!

extraits.titre: Must have for breakout prone skin!!
extraits.texte: I still get acne even after 40 and have a hard time not popping or picking. I slways dread the morning if I have to go somewhere and try to cover the mess I've made, especially if the wound it still open and trying to heal. This powder has been a game changer… it really sticks and doesn't clog the pores. I only wish they would comemout with darker tints so that the area didnt look so light and yellowish. My fix for that has been to take a powder about 3 shades darker than my skin tone and press it over the yellow powder to darken it enough to blend in. Other than that, it's perfect and I couldn't do without it

I dont write many reviews but felt inclined to do so for this one. I've been using it everyday cor about three weeks now and I'm honestly in love with this formula. My skin has always struggled with acne and this product has helped clear up my acne so much on my face while providing oil control throughout thr day. I apply it once in the morning and once in the afternoon and thats all I need. It 100% works better than other finishing powders Ive tried. The only con would be that the container it comes in is messy to get powder out of. The formula itself has a light trace smell of sulfur, but it doesnt stick around for very long and it doesnt bother me too much. The tradeoff of having a clear face and superior oil control is worth it in my opinion. Hoping they never stop making this product!
Doesnt blend well and doest cover red well. I will stick to dr. jart tigergrass and then finishing with laura mercier ulta blur finishing powder.
